ai.overview: The belt changes hands with every loss or draw, tracing an unbroken chain back to the league's first game. Nashville and Kansas City have met 4 times previously but never with the belt at stake.
key_matchups: Nashville SC's recent surge (won their last 3 games) meets Sporting Kansas City's inconsistent form (tied their last 1 game after back-to-back losses)
Home belt defense for Nashville SC (19-3-6) against a Kansas City side with a 6-18-4 record but extensive belt history (held it 21 times before)
Head-to-head series split at 2-2 all-time, with Nashville SC winning the most recent meeting 3-0 in 2023
ai.betting_angles: Nashville SC enters as the Elo favorite, backed by a 19-3-6 record and three straight wins including a 4-1 victory at Austin FC in their most recent outing. Sporting Kansas City's 6-18-4 season record and recent draw (3-3 vs Portland Timbers) suggest they'll struggle on the road. The all-time head-to-head stands even at 2-2, but Nashville won the last meeting 3-0.
ai.prediction_writeup: Nashville SC's home form and three-game winning streak position them well to defend the belt for the first time. Their 19-3-6 record dwarfs Sporting Kansas City's 6-18-4 mark, and the Elo model favors the home side. While Kansas City has held the belt 21 times historically, their current form (just tied 3-3 with Portland after losing two straight) suggests they'll struggle to claim it here. Nashville's recent attacking output, including a 4-1 win at Austin and a 3-0 win over Chicago, should be enough to keep the belt at home.
